run_compute_metrics: run the compute_metrics script with --exp and --paramStr args to evaluate PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics
run_rgb_ssim: run rgb_ssim to compute the structural similarity index between two RGB images
run_rgb_lpips: run rgb_lpips to compute the LPIPS distance between two RGB images using alex or vgg network
run_init_lpips: run init_lpips to initialize an LPIPS model with alex or vgg network on a device
run_findItem: run findItem to search a list of strings for an item that starts with a target prefix
